pre_flight_question: Are the five dimension weights deployment parameters or protocol-defined defaults? RESOLVED from draft §5.7: both — the draft gives protocol-defined defaults (SAS 0.30, JS 0.25, ES 0.20, PS 0.15, AS 0.10) AND states 'Weights are operator-configurable.' Sample accepts configurable weights with these as defaults.
note: Plan v6's Step 4 coding-assistant block described a different, stale PT model (trust_band state machine; SAS=scope adherence, JS=judgement stability, ES=escalation sensitivity, PS=principal signal responsiveness, AS=anomaly score). This corpus is built against the actual draft-sato-soos-pt-02 text, where SAS/JS/ES/PS/AS = Self-Assessment/Judgment/Effectiveness/Precision/Adaptability. See MJWT precedent for how such plan/draft drift is handled.
